exposure: Prophylactic phenylephrine infusion (50 μg/min) during cesarean section under spinal anesthesia
Baseline systolic blood pressure (<120 mmHg vs ≥120 mmHg)
cohort: 141 pregnant women undergoing cesarean section under spinal anesthesia
finding: Prophylactic infusion of phenylephrine 50 μg/min is safe and demonstrates efficacy in reducing maternal hypotension providing adequate maternal hemodynamic stability during CS under spinal anesthesia.
